import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kmpSearch_precond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  haystack.size < 1000000 ∧ 
  needle.size < 1000000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- `bump P k c` : after the fallback loop stopped at candidate length `k`,
either the character matches (extend by one) or we restart from `0`. -/
def bump (P : Nat → UInt8) (k : Nat) (c : UInt8) : Nat :=
  if P k = c then k + 1 else 0

/-- The KMP fallback ("failure") loop: while `k > 0` and `P k ≠ c`, replace `k` by `F k`
(the length of the longest proper border of `P[0..k)`).  `fuel` bounds the number of
iterations; `k` iterations always suffice because `F k < k`. -/
def fbLoop (P : Nat → UInt8) (F : Nat → Nat) (c : UInt8) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, k => k
  | fuel + 1, k =>
      if k = 0 then 0
      else if P k = c then k
      else fbLoop P F c fuel (F k)

/-- Preprocessing: build the border table `B`, where `B[q]` is the length of the
longest proper prefix of `P[0..q)` that is also a suffix of it. -/
def buildLoop (P : Nat → UInt8) : Nat → Nat → Array Nat → Array Nat
  | 0, _, B => B
  | fuel + 1, i, B =>
      buildLoop P fuel (i + 1)
        (B.push (bump P (fbLoop P (fun q => B.getD q 0) (P i) (B.getD i 0) (B.getD i 0)) (P i)))

/-- The KMP scanning loop.  `q` is the length of the currently matched prefix of the
pattern; on a mismatch we jump using the border table instead of re-scanning the text. -/
def searchLoop (T P : Nat → UInt8) (m : Nat) (B : Array Nat) :
    Nat → Nat → Nat → Array Nat → Array Nat
  | 0, _, _, res => res
  | fuel + 1, i, q, res =>
      let q2 := bump P (fbLoop P (fun j => B.getD j 0) (T i) q q) (T i)
      if q2 = m then
        searchLoop T P m B fuel (i + 1) (B.getD m 0) (res.push (i + 1 - m))
      else
        searchLoop T P m B fuel (i + 1) q2 res
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def kmpSearch (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (_ : kmpSearch_precond haystack needle) : Array Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  if needle.size = 0 then
    Array.range (haystack.size + 1)
  else
    let P : Nat → UInt8 := fun j => needle.getD j 0
    let T : Nat → UInt8 := fun i => haystack.getD i 0
    let B := buildLoop P (needle.size - 1) 1 #[0, 0]
    searchLoop T P needle.size B haystack.size 0 0 #[]
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition auxiliary definitions
def matchesAt (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size ∧
  (∀ j, j < needle.size → haystack.getD (i + j) 0 = needle.getD j 0)

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kmpSearch_postcond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (result : Array Nat) (_ : kmpSearch_precond haystack needle) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ i, i < result.size → matchesAt haystack needle (result.getD i 0)) ∧ -- Soundness
  (∀ i, matchesAt haystack needle i → ∃ k, k < result.size ∧ result.getD k 0 = i) -- Completeness
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

/-- `ME T P i q` : the prefix of `P` of length `q` occurs in `T` ending at position `i`. -/
def ME (T P : Nat → UInt8) (i q : Nat) : Prop :=
  q ≤ i ∧ ∀ j, j < q → P j = T (i - q + j)

/-- `ME P P q k` says `k` is a border length of `P[0..q)`. -/
@[reducible]
def IsF (P : Nat → UInt8) (B : Array Nat) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  B.getD q 0 < q ∧ ME P P q (B.getD q 0) ∧ ∀ k, k < q → ME P P q k → k ≤ B.getD q 0

theorem ME_zero (T P : Nat → UInt8) (i : Nat) : ME T P i 0 :=
  ⟨Nat.zero_le i, fun _ hj => absurd hj (by omega)⟩

/-- A border of a matched prefix is itself matched at the same position. -/
theorem ME_trans {T P : Nat → UInt8} {i a b : Nat}
    (h1 : ME T P i a) (h2 : ME P P a b) : ME T P i b := by
  obtain ⟨ha, hA⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨hb, hB⟩ := h2
  refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  have e1 := hB j hj
  have e2 := hA (a - b + j) (by omega)
  rw [e1, e2]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Two prefixes matched at the same position: the shorter is a border of the longer. -/
theorem ME_restr {T P : Nat → UInt8} {i a b : Nat}
    (h1 : ME T P i a) (h2 : ME T P i b) (hba : b ≤ a) : ME P P a b := by
  obtain ⟨ha, hA⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨_, hB⟩ := h2
  refine ⟨hba, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  have e1 := hB j hj
  have e2 := hA (a - b + j) (by omega)
  rw [e1, e2]
  congr 1
  omega

theorem ME_pred {T P : Nat → UInt8} {i x : Nat} (h : ME T P (i + 1) x) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    ME T P i (x - 1) ∧ P (x - 1) = T i := by
  obtain ⟨hle, hall⟩ := h
  refine ⟨⟨by omega, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    have e := hall j (by omega)
    rw [e]
    congr 1
    omega
  · have e := hall (x - 1) (by omega)
    rw [e]
    congr 1
    omega

theorem ME_succ {T P : Nat → UInt8} {i k : Nat} (h : ME T P i k) (hc : P k = T i) :
    ME T P (i + 1) (k + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨hle, hall⟩ := h
  refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j k with hjk | hjk
  · have e := hall j hjk
    rw [e]
    congr 1
    omega
  · have hjk' : j = k := by omega
    subst hjk'
    rw [hc]
    congr 1
    omega

theorem getD_of_lt (a : Array Nat) (i : Nat) (h : i < a.size) : a.getD i 0 = a[i] := by
  simp [Array.getD, h]

theorem getD_push_lt (B : Array Nat) (x q : Nat) (h : q < B.size) :
    (B.push x).getD q 0 = B.getD q 0 := by
  have h2 : q < (B.push x).size := by simp [Array.size_push]; omega
  rw [getD_of_lt _ _ h2, getD_of_lt _ _ h]
  simp [Array.getElem_push, h]

theorem getD_push_self (B : Array Nat) (x : Nat) : (B.push x).getD B.size 0 = x := by
  have h2 : B.size < (B.push x).size := by simp [Array.size_push]
  rw [getD_of_lt _ _ h2]
  simp [Array.getElem_push]

theorem IsF_push (P : Nat → UInt8) (B : Array Nat) (x q : Nat) (h : q < B.size)
    (hq : IsF P B q) : IsF P (B.push x) q := by
  rw [IsF, getD_push_lt B x q h]
  exact hq

theorem getD_range {n i : Nat} (h : i < n) : (Array.range n).getD i 0 = i := by
  have h2 : i < (Array.range n).size := by simpa using h
  rw [getD_of_lt _ _ h2]
  simp

/-- Correctness of the fallback loop, stated abstractly so that it can be used both
for the preprocessing phase (`G = ME P P i`) and the scanning phase (`G = ME T P i`). -/
theorem fbLoop_spec (P : Nat → UInt8) (F : Nat → Nat) (c : UInt8)
    (G G' : Nat → Prop) (bnd : Nat)
    (hF : ∀ q, 1 ≤ q → q ≤ bnd →
      F q < q ∧ ME P P q (F q) ∧ ∀ k, k < q → ME P P q k → k ≤ F q)
    (hrestr : ∀ a b, G a → G b → b ≤ a → ME P P a b)
    (htrans : ∀ a b, G a → ME P P a b → G b)
    (hstep : ∀ x, G' x → 1 ≤ x → G (x - 1) ∧ P (x - 1) = c) :
    ∀ fuel k, k ≤ fuel → k ≤ bnd → G k → (∀ x, G' x → x ≤ k + 1) →
      G (fbLoop P F c fuel k) ∧ (∀ x, G' x → x ≤ fbLoop P F c fuel k + 1) ∧
      (fbLoop P F c fuel k = 0 ∨ P (fbLoop P F c fuel k) = c) ∧
      fbLoop P F c fuel k ≤ bnd := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro k hk hkb hG hb
    have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
    subst hk0
    rw [fbLoop]
    exact ⟨hG, hb, Or.inl rfl, hkb⟩
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro k hk hkb hG hb
    rw [fbLoop]
    split
    next h0 =>
      subst h0
      exact ⟨hG, hb, Or.inl rfl, hkb⟩
    next h0 =>
      split
      next h1 => exact ⟨hG, hb, Or.inr h1, hkb⟩
      next h1 =>
        have h1k : 1 ≤ k := by omega
        obtain ⟨hlt, hpre, hmax⟩ := hF k h1k hkb
        refine ih (F k) (by omega) (by omega) (htrans k (F k) hG hpre) ?_
        intro x hx
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x with hx0 | hxp
        · omega
        · obtain ⟨hGx, hPx⟩ := hstep x hx hxp
          have hxk : x ≤ k := by
            have hle := hb x hx
            by_contra hcon
            have hxe : x = k + 1 := by omega
            subst hxe
            simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hPx
            exact h1 hPx
          have hps := hrestr k (x - 1) hG hGx (by omega)
          have := hmax (x - 1) (by omega) hps
          omega

/-- Correctness of the preprocessing phase: every entry of the border table is
a border of the corresponding prefix, and it is the longest such proper border. -/
theorem buildLoop_spec (P : Nat → UInt8) :
    ∀ fuel i B, 1 ≤ i → B.size = i + 1 → (∀ q, 1 ≤ q → q < i + 1 → IsF P B q) →
      (buildLoop P fuel i B).size = i + 1 + fuel ∧
      (∀ q, 1 ≤ q → q < i + 1 + fuel → IsF P (buildLoop P fuel i B) q) := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro i B _ hs hinv
    rw [buildLoop]
    exact ⟨hs, by simpa using hinv⟩
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro i B h1 hs hinv
    obtain ⟨hlt_i, hpre_i, hmax_i⟩ := hinv i h1 (by omega)
    have hbound : ∀ x, (x < i + 1 ∧ ME P P (i + 1) x) → x ≤ B.getD i 0 + 1 := by
      intro x hx
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x with h | h
      · omega
      · have h2 := (ME_pred hx.2 h).1
        have := hmax_i (x - 1) (by omega) h2
        omega
    have key := fbLoop_spec P (fun q => B.getD q 0) (P i) (ME P P i)
        (fun x => x < i + 1 ∧ ME P P (i + 1) x) (B.getD i 0)
        (fun q' hq1 hq2 => hinv q' hq1 (by omega))
        (fun a b ha hb hba => ME_restr ha hb hba)
        (fun a b ha hab => ME_trans ha hab)
        (fun x hx hx1 => ME_pred hx.2 hx1)
        (B.getD i 0) (B.getD i 0) le_rfl le_rfl hpre_i hbound
    obtain ⟨hMEk, hbnd, hcase, hkle⟩ := key
    set k := fbLoop P (fun q => B.getD q 0) (P i) (B.getD i 0) (B.getD i 0) with hkdef
    have hnew : IsF P (B.push (bump P k (P i))) (i + 1) := by
      have hsz : (B.push (bump P k (P i))).size = i + 2 := by
        rw [Array.size_push, hs]
      have hg : (B.push (bump P k (P i))).getD (i + 1) 0 = bump P k (P i) := by
        have := getD_push_self B (bump P k (P i))
        rwa [hs] at this
      rw [IsF, hg]
      unfold bump
      split
      next hA =>
        refine ⟨by omega, ME_succ hMEk hA, ?_⟩
        intro x hx hMEx
        exact hbnd x ⟨hx, hMEx⟩
      next hA =>
        have hz : k = 0 := by
          rcases hcase with h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd h hA
        refine ⟨by omega, ME_zero _ _ _, ?_⟩
        intro x hx hMEx
        have hb2 := hbnd x ⟨hx, hMEx⟩
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x with h | h
        · omega
        · exfalso
          have hp := (ME_pred hMEx h).2
          have hx1 : x = 1 := by omega
          subst hx1
          simp only [Nat.sub_self] at hp
          rw [hz] at hA
          exact hA hp
    have hinv' : ∀ q, 1 ≤ q → q < i + 1 + 1 → IsF P (B.push (bump P k (P i))) q := by
      intro q hq1 hq2
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge q (i + 1) with h | h
      · exact IsF_push P B _ q (by omega) (hinv q hq1 h)
      · have : q = i + 1 := by omega
        subst this
        exact hnew
    have hres := ih (i + 1) (B.push (bump P k (P i))) (by omega)
        (by rw [Array.size_push, hs]) hinv'
    rw [buildLoop, ← hkdef]
    exact ⟨by omega, fun q hq1 hq2 => hres.2 q hq1 (by omega)⟩

/-- Correctness of the scanning phase. -/
theorem searchLoop_spec (T P : Nat → UInt8) (m : Nat) (B : Array Nat)
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hB : ∀ q, 1 ≤ q → q ≤ m → IsF P B q) :
    ∀ fuel i q res, q < m → ME T P i q →
      (∀ k, k < m → ME T P i k → k ≤ q) →
      (∀ idx, idx < res.size → ∃ e, e ≤ i ∧ ME T P e m ∧ res.getD idx 0 = e - m) →
      (∀ e, e ≤ i → ME T P e m → ∃ idx, idx < res.size ∧ res.getD idx 0 = e - m) →
      (∀ idx, idx < (searchLoop T P m B fuel i q res).size →
        ∃ e, e ≤ i + fuel ∧ ME T P e m ∧
          (searchLoop T P m B fuel i q res).getD idx 0 = e - m) ∧
      (∀ e, e ≤ i + fuel → ME T P e m →
        ∃ idx, idx < (searchLoop T P m B fuel i q res).size ∧
          (searchLoop T P m B fuel i q res).getD idx 0 = e - m) := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro i q res _ _ _ hsnd hcmp
    rw [searchLoop]
    exact ⟨by simpa using hsnd, by simpa using hcmp⟩
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro i q res hqm hME hmax hsnd hcmp
    have hbound : ∀ x, (x ≤ m ∧ ME T P (i + 1) x) → x ≤ q + 1 := by
      intro x hx
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x with h | h
      · omega
      · have h2 := (ME_pred hx.2 h).1
        have := hmax (x - 1) (by omega) h2
        omega
    have key := fbLoop_spec P (fun j => B.getD j 0) (T i) (ME T P i)
        (fun x => x ≤ m ∧ ME T P (i + 1) x) q
        (fun q' hq1 hq2 => hB q' hq1 (by omega))
        (fun a b ha hb hba => ME_restr ha hb hba)
        (fun a b ha hab => ME_trans ha hab)
        (fun x hx hx1 => ME_pred hx.2 hx1)
        q q le_rfl le_rfl hME hbound
    obtain ⟨hMEq1, hbnd, hcase, hq1le⟩ := key
    set q1 := fbLoop P (fun j => B.getD j 0) (T i) q q with hq1def
    have hstate : ME T P (i + 1) (bump P q1 (T i)) ∧
        (∀ x, x ≤ m → ME T P (i + 1) x → x ≤ bump P q1 (T i)) ∧
        bump P q1 (T i) ≤ m := by
      unfold bump
      split
      next hA =>
        exact ⟨ME_succ hMEq1 hA, fun x hxm hx => hbnd x ⟨hxm, hx⟩, by omega⟩
      next hA =>
        have hz : q1 = 0 := by
          rcases hcase with h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd h hA
        refine ⟨ME_zero _ _ _, ?_, by omega⟩
        intro x hxm hx
        have hb2 := hbnd x ⟨hxm, hx⟩
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x with h | h
        · omega
        · exfalso
          have hp := (ME_pred hx h).2
          have hx1 : x = 1 := by omega
          subst hx1
          simp only [Nat.sub_self] at hp
          rw [hz] at hA
          exact hA hp
    obtain ⟨hMEq2, hq2max, hq2le⟩ := hstate
    rw [searchLoop, ← hq1def]
    split
    next hEq =>
      rw [hEq] at hMEq2 hq2max
      obtain ⟨hFlt, hFpre, hFmax⟩ := hB m hm le_rfl
      have hMEnew : ME T P (i + 1) (B.getD m 0) := ME_trans hMEq2 hFpre
      have hmaxnew : ∀ k, k < m → ME T P (i + 1) k → k ≤ B.getD m 0 := by
        intro k hk hMEk
        exact hFmax k hk (ME_restr hMEq2 hMEk (by omega))
      have hsnd' : ∀ idx, idx < (res.push (i + 1 - m)).size →
          ∃ e, e ≤ i + 1 ∧ ME T P e m ∧ (res.push (i + 1 - m)).getD idx 0 = e - m := by
        intro idx hidx
        rw [Array.size_push] at hidx
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge idx res.size with h | h
        · obtain ⟨e, he1, he2, he3⟩ := hsnd idx h
          exact ⟨e, by omega, he2, by rw [getD_push_lt _ _ _ h]; exact he3⟩
        · have hidx' : idx = res.size := by omega
          subst hidx'
          exact ⟨i + 1, le_rfl, hMEq2, getD_push_self _ _⟩
      have hcmp' : ∀ e, e ≤ i + 1 → ME T P e m →
          ∃ idx, idx < (res.push (i + 1 - m)).size ∧
            (res.push (i + 1 - m)).getD idx 0 = e - m := by
        intro e he hMEe
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge e (i + 1) with h | h
        · obtain ⟨idx, h1, h2⟩ := hcmp e (by omega) hMEe
          exact ⟨idx, by rw [Array.size_push]; omega,
            by rw [getD_push_lt _ _ _ h1]; exact h2⟩
        · have he' : e = i + 1 := by omega
          subst he'
          exact ⟨res.size, by rw [Array.size_push]; omega, getD_push_self _ _⟩
      have hres := ih (i + 1) (B.getD m 0) (res.push (i + 1 - m)) hFlt hMEnew hmaxnew hsnd' hcmp'
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro idx hidx
        obtain ⟨e, he1, he2, he3⟩ := hres.1 idx hidx
        exact ⟨e, by omega, he2, he3⟩
      · intro e he hMEe
        exact hres.2 e (by omega) hMEe
    next hNe =>
      have hq2lt : bump P q1 (T i) < m := by omega
      have hmaxnew : ∀ k, k < m → ME T P (i + 1) k → k ≤ bump P q1 (T i) :=
        fun k hk h => hq2max k (by omega) h
      have hsnd' : ∀ idx, idx < res.size →
          ∃ e, e ≤ i + 1 ∧ ME T P e m ∧ res.getD idx 0 = e - m := by
        intro idx hidx
        obtain ⟨e, he1, he2, he3⟩ := hsnd idx hidx
        exact ⟨e, by omega, he2, he3⟩
      have hcmp' : ∀ e, e ≤ i + 1 → ME T P e m →
          ∃ idx, idx < res.size ∧ res.getD idx 0 = e - m := by
        intro e he hMEe
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge e (i + 1) with h | h
        · exact hcmp e (by omega) hMEe
        · exfalso
          have he' : e = i + 1 := by omega
          subst he'
          have := hq2max m le_rfl hMEe
          omega
      have hres := ih (i + 1) (bump P q1 (T i)) res hq2lt hMEq2 hmaxnew hsnd' hcmp'
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro idx hidx
        obtain ⟨e, he1, he2, he3⟩ := hres.1 idx hidx
        exact ⟨e, by omega, he2, he3⟩
      · intro e he hMEe
        exact hres.2 e (by omega) hMEe
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem kmpSearch_postcond_satisfied (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (h_precond : kmpSearch_precond haystack needle) :
    kmpSearch_postcond haystack needle (kmpSearch haystack needle h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  simp only [kmpSearch, kmpSearch_postcond]
  split
  next hm0 =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i hi
      rw [Array.size_range] at hi
      rw [getD_range hi, matchesAt, hm0]
      refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      exact absurd hj (by omega)
    · intro i hi
      obtain ⟨h1, _⟩ := hi
      rw [hm0] at h1
      refine ⟨i, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Array.size_range]; omega
      · rw [getD_range (by omega : i < haystack.size + 1)]
  next hm0 =>
    have hm : 1 ≤ needle.size := by omega
    set P : Nat → UInt8 := fun j => needle.getD j 0 with hPdef
    set T : Nat → UInt8 := fun i => haystack.getD i 0 with hTdef
    have hinit : ∀ q, 1 ≤ q → q < 1 + 1 → IsF P (#[0, 0] : Array Nat) q := by
      intro q hq1 hq2
      have hq : q = 1 := by omega
      subst hq
      have hg : (#[0, 0] : Array Nat).getD 1 0 = 0 := rfl
      rw [IsF, hg]
      refine ⟨by omega, ME_zero _ _ _, ?_⟩
      intro k hk _
      omega
    have hbuild := buildLoop_spec P (needle.size - 1) 1 (#[0, 0] : Array Nat)
      le_rfl rfl hinit
    set B := buildLoop P (needle.size - 1) 1 (#[0, 0] : Array Nat) with hBdef
    have hB : ∀ q, 1 ≤ q → q ≤ needle.size → IsF P B q := by
      intro q hq1 hq2
      exact hbuild.2 q hq1 (by omega)
    have hsearch := searchLoop_spec T P needle.size B hm hB haystack.size 0 0 #[]
      (by omega) (ME_zero _ _ _)
      (fun k _ hk => hk.1)
      (fun idx hidx => absurd hidx (by simp))
      (fun e he hMEe => absurd hMEe.1 (by omega))
    obtain ⟨hsound, hcomp⟩ := hsearch
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i hi
      obtain ⟨e, he1, he2, he3⟩ := hsound i hi
      obtain ⟨hle, hall⟩ := he2
      rw [he3, matchesAt]
      refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      have hx := hall j hj
      rw [hPdef, hTdef] at hx
      simp only at hx
      exact hx.symm
    · intro i hi
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hi
      have hMEe : ME T P (i + needle.size) needle.size := by
        refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
        intro j hj
        rw [hPdef, hTdef]
        simp only
        rw [← h2 j hj]
        congr 1
        omega
